| **WronglyDrawn-@VERSION@-android.apk** | 安卓 8.0 及以上。下载后点开安装，系统会让你允许“安装未知应用”。以后的版本可以直接覆盖安装，进度保留。 |

*Android 8.0+: open the APK to install it (allow installs from unknown sources). Later versions install over it and keep your progress. The web zip is for self-hosting: serve it over HTTP, it does not run from a double-click. Or just [play in the browser](https://wrongdraw.maequeen.top/).*
